[EN] We need to hurt argon behemoths, particularly those involved with collecting iteris shards.

Kill suulvir harvesters and arzakaar guardians throughout {@Rgn:50001}.

Report to {@LinkCreature:250#1009} at {@Rgn:50003} when you're finished.
[ES] Necesitamos dañar a los behemoths argon, en particular a los involucrados en la recolección de iteris shards.

Mata a los suulvir harvesters y arzakaar guardians en todo {@Rgn:50001}.

Preséntate ante {@LinkCreature:250#1009} en {@Rgn:50003} cuando termines.

[EN] Victory's assured with soldiers like you on our side.
[ES] La victoria está asegurada con soldados como tú de nuestro lado.

[EN] You didn't accomplish the mission objectives. Keep trying.
[ES] No cumpliste con los objetivos de la misión. Sigue intentándolo.
